'''Samar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Khil]], who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]] He served the Republic as an officer within [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]]. In [[3957 BBY]], Samar was among a team of Republic agents who went on a mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]], where they recovered a [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinder]] that held the command codes for the sensor systems on [[Darth Revan's flagship]]. Afterwards, they traveled to the Republic ship [[Viscount (Galactic Republic starship)|''Viscount'']] and assisted the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bastila Shan]] in a mission to capture the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]]. During the mission, Samar and the other agents encountered the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Voren]].<ref name="DR" />
